source: ST_TextShapeType (ECMA-376 Part 1 section 20.1.10.76), the MSOSPT ordinals VML names the same warps by, and every preset's guide formulas and paths from presetTextWarpDefinitions.xml (ECMA-376 Part 1 annex; Apache-2.0 copy in Apache OpenOffice main/oox/source/export). 'drawing': 'none' = no warp (textNoShape); 'fit' = textPlain, two straight paths, the text rectangle fitted to the box (what a Word watermark is); 'envelope' = paths taken in (top, bottom) pairs, one band per pair, the tight ink rectangle of each band's lines mapped into it by arc length; 'follow' = each path is a baseline the glyphs are rotated onto rigidly. 'adjustments' = the a:avLst guide names with their default and handle range; 'guides' / 'paths' = the preset's program in the drawingml-default-program-v1 atom form ({ref: name} or a literal). Measured against Word: docs/office-graphics/TEXT-WARP.md. apps/api/app/services/office_text_warp.json and apps/web/lib/office-text-warp.shared.json are byte-identical copies, pinned by both test suites.
